units.source_text: 尽管这么说，她也淡淡地涂上了口红。

en.t: Even so, she lightly put on some lipstick.

units.source_text: 秀男多么希望苗子再把手巾摘下来，让他看一眼她那长发垂肩的姿态啊。

en.t: How deeply Hideo wished that Naeko would take off the kerchief again and let him have one glimpse of her with her long hair falling over her shoulders.
But how could he possibly ask her?

units.source_text: 这点，苗子慌忙戴上头巾的时候就意识到了。

en.t: Naeko realized this the moment she hurriedly put the headscarf back on.
